name: Manitoba: income and sales tax, 2026
name_fr: Manitoba : impôt sur le revenu et taxes de vente, 2026
description: Provincial/territorial personal income tax brackets, basic personal amount and sales tax rates for Manitoba for the 2026 tax year, with estimated take-home pay for a single employee at three salaries.

sales_tax.note: HST replaces GST and PST in participating provinces. PST/QST bases and exemptions differ from GST and are set provincially; only headline rates are recorded here.

attributes.notes: Manitoba froze indexation of its brackets and basic personal amount from the 2025 tax year (T4008-MB). CONFLICT: the CRA current-year page, as read on 2026-10-30, shows thresholds of $47,564 and $101,200 (equal to 47,000 and 100,000 indexed by 1.2%), while CRA T4127 Table 8.1 and T4008-MB show $47,000 and $100,000. This record and the worked examples use $47,000 / $100,000. Manitoba BPA phases out between net income $200,000 and $400,000.

sources.title: Current year tax rates and income brackets (2026) — page modified 2026-06-25
T4127 Payroll Deductions Formulas, 122nd edition, effective 1 January 2026 (Table 8.1 rates and thresholds; basic personal amounts; CPP/QPP/EI/QPIP parameters)
GST/HST calculator (and rates for provinces) — rates on or after 1 April 2025; page modified 2025-04-01
T4008 Payroll Deductions Supplementary Tables — Manitoba, January 2026, general information

verification.notes: Two CRA pages disagree on Manitoba thresholds (see notes). Rates and BPA agree.

limitations: Headline rates only: no refundable credits, low-income reductions, dividend or capital-gains treatment, or property taxes. The net-pay figures in attributes are estimates (method in nat-ca-take-home-pay-examples-2026), not official figures.
